agent.asking: Searching the workspace and asking your model…
agent.description: Answers about this workspace from your own LLM, grounded in the Brokspace index, with the sources it used. Without an LLM, answers with what the local index finds. Nothing leaves your machine unless brok.yml points at a hosted model. Commands: `/review` (uncommitted changes), `/review staged`, `/review base <ref>`, `/skill <name> <input>`.

settings.agentsText: Brokspace in the coding agents you already use.

settings.bugFailed: The report could not be prepared: {0}
settings.bugPrivacy: The report adds versions, your OS, brok doctor, recent metrics, the end of the log and brok.yml. Secrets are masked and your home folder shows as ~. Nothing is sent until you submit the issue on GitHub.
settings.bugReadyText: Saved to {0}. Open the issue: the summary and the diagnostics are filled in. Attach the report file for the log and the configuration, then submit.
settings.bugTitle: What went wrong, in one line
settings.coldWeightText: Results from other submodules and nested repositories are scaled by this (0 to 1).

settings.defaultProviderText: Every question, review and skill goes through brok to this provider.
settings.diagnosticsText: How Brokspace performs on this machine, what failed lately and what to fix. Metrics stay local.
settings.excludeText: Glob patterns, one per line. .gitignore is always honored too.
settings.exportSkillsText: Copies the skills to .claude/skills and .agents/skills again, after you add or change one.
settings.limitText: Also how much context a question gets.
settings.linkDescription: How this workspace uses it (optional, helps the AI)
settings.linkDescriptionPlaceholder: Carts and payments; we call its createOrder API
settings.linkWeightText: Results from linked workspaces are scaled by this (0 to 1), so your code wins ties.
settings.linked: Linked {0}. Questions and searches now include it.
settings.linksText: Other workspaces this one depends on, on this machine or as git repositories. Their code and memories are searched with yours.
settings.memoryBody: Details: why, where, what to watch out for (Markdown)

settings.memoryGlobalText: Your personal memories, shared by every workspace (preferences, conventions).

settings.memoryText: What Brokspace remembers between sessions: private to you, shared with your team through git, or global to all your workspaces.
settings.memoryTitle: What to remember, in one line
settings.modelText: The LLM brok sends questions to. Without one, Brokspace answers from the local index.

settings.noLinks: Working on a service that calls another one? Link it: questions and searches then know both, and their memories.
settings.noMemories: Nothing remembered yet. Add a decision here, or ask your coding agent to remember something.

settings.ownIndexText: A Brokspace workspace: its own index and memories are used.

settings.serviceText: The background brok keeps the index in step with your edits and runs the agent and shards.
settings.submodulesText: Git submodules and nested repositories get their own small index, quick to update.

settings.unlinkConfirm: Unlink {0}? Its folder is not touched; the copy and index Brokspace keeps for it are deleted.
